The `create_url_adapter` method in `app.py` explicitly passes `server_name=self.config["SERVER_NAME"]` to `self.url_map.bind_to_environ` when a request is provided. This is the root cause of the issue: when the client connects to an internal DNS name (e.g., `instance-1231.example.org`), the routing adapter ignores it because it expects the `SERVER_NAME` to be set.

To fix this, we need to modify the logic so that the routing adapter can handle requests with arbitrary hostnames, even if they don't match the `SERVER_NAME`. This should be done in `app.py` or in the `url_map` logic.
